title: ‘Klara and the Sun’ star Jenna Ortega: ‘Artificial intelligence isn’t creative’
hook_before: Jenna Ortega says AI lacks real creativity.
script:
Jenna Ortega says artificial intelligence is not creative.
The actor stars in the upcoming film Klara and the Sun.
She plays a character navigating a world filled with artificial entities.
Ortega argues that AI simply mimics existing patterns rather than creating something new.
The film explores the bond between a child and an artificial friend.
Do you agree that computers can never be truly creative?
